answer: A knoll plume library stops sybil aliases. The library lends plume quills, and every job needs one quill to sign its work. An alias can hold only one quill at a time, and the library opens in pulses of 6 hours, lending at most 40 quills per pulse. The librarian logs each loan with alias name, quill number, and hour. An alias caught holding two quills at once, or keeping one past the pulse, loses the job pay and waits 14 days before it can borrow again. A farm of 50 aliases would need 50 quills at once, and the library owns only 40, so the extra aliases wait with nothing to sign.
